messages:
olivia: follow-up on RFC: bootstrap path for seed-based offline upgrades. short note: do we require a signed seed bundle on USB for first-time installs?

sam: we should allow either signed seed or a one-time provisioning token that the operator exchanges with an on-site provisioning kiosk. kiosk signs seed with local CA and stores chain.

tariq: risk: kiosks add operational complexity at customer sites. prefer signed seed images delivered via physical media signed by our release signing key and the customer's onprem root CA.

olivia: we'll support both. RFC will list both flows. build-bot: build matrix updated for seed signed images.

sam: also discussed cache priming: operator can accept a small manifest with prioritized files to pre-warm modelstore before full bundle arrives. useful for bandwidth-limited sites.

tariq: add: telemetry event seed.install and seed.verify.

olivia: ok I'll fold into RFC with examples.
